entry.author: NZ On Air Music
entry.summary:
Country in the house! 🤠 From family band beginnings at five years old to sharing stages with Tami Neilson and Six60, Rosie Teese sits down with Charlotte Ryan to reflect on her journey in music, plus the story behind her chart‑topping single Real Good Man.
